aspect: The defect is genuine and is not the reason
description: Every substantial application contains something that can be called deficient. Selecting one and citing it produces a refusal that is literally accurate and substantively false.
energy_note: True on its face, and not why.

aspect: It cannot be distinguished from good-faith rigour
description: An officer applying the same scrutiny to everyone and an officer looking for a reason produce identical paperwork. The target has no way to tell which happened, and neither does any reviewer.
energy_note: Indistinguishable from somebody just being careful.

aspect: Fixing it produces a new defect
description: The applicant corrects the transcript issue and is then asked about the employer letter; corrects that and is asked about the itinerary. The supply of available defects is not exhausted by curing them.
energy_note: Every fix reveals the next objection.

description: First time: the degree certificate was not notarised. Second time: the notarisation was more than six months old. Third time: the employer letter did not specify the supervision structure. Each objection is correct. None was mentioned when it could have been raised together.
energy_note: Three refusals, three true reasons, one decision.

aspect: The target learns to over-document everything, forever
description: The permanent adaptation is anticipatory excess: notarising what does not need notarising, explaining what was not asked. It is expensive, it reads as anxious, and it is entirely rational.
energy_note: Over-preparing for the rest of your life.
